title: hieracium aureum
intro: Hieracium aureum, commonly known as Golden Hawk's Beard or Golden Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium aureum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenoids, which have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to support digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate joint pain.
